title: Biomedical Engineering
text: Biomedical engineering combines engineering and science to design and develop technologies. Students might explore biology, mathematics, coding and prototyping. College requirements vary and must be checked on official program pages.

title: Software Development
text: Software development involves designing and building applications and systems. Try a simple app, game or debugging project. Education paths vary.

title: Digital Product Design
text: Product design explores how people use apps and websites. Try prototyping an interface and gathering feedback. This is an illustrative exploration description, not a verified program requirement.

title: Environmental Science
text: Environmental science investigates the environment and potential solutions to environmental problems. Explore field observations, data analysis or science communication.

title: College Pathway Checklist
text: Compare programs and majors; verify current prerequisites, costs, financial aid and deadlines on each institution's official pages. This demo contains no verified college-specific admissions dates or requirements.

title: Financial Aid Exploration
text: Learn about different types of aid. Requirements and deadlines change: consult current official sources and a counselor before applying.

title: Explore Occupations
text: Occupational information can help students explore interests and work activities. Interest choices are not career suitability scores or predictions.
